primary_sources.title: Dedieu--Sernesi, Equigeneric and equisingular families of curves on surfaces, author version
primary_sources.used_statement: Complete pages7-8: normal-sheaf deformation and obstruction spaces, relation to morphism spaces and absence of torsion for immersions. Complete pages10-11: Theorem2.8 and its proof, with distinct triple and tangent-pair arguments. The two-point-only eta1 use is derived for initially at-most-double-valued immersions, not claimed as their unrestricted nodal theorem.

primary_sources.title: Neumann--Norbury, The Orevkov invariant of an affine plane curve
primary_sources.used_statement: Complete PDF2 Definition2/Theorem1 and complete proof PDF4-5: LCP preserves the Orevkov invariant. The end is preserved on a fixed compactification; no global moduli connectedness hypothesis is imported. The original tangential complement group is not asserted abelian.

primary_sources.title: Nori, Zariski conjecture and related problems (1983)
primary_sources.used_statement: Complete PDF28/printed331 Proposition3.27 and full proof: nodal union, transverse removed boundary and componentwise self-intersection greater than twice self-node count. Applied only AFTER the algebraic nodal deformation. Earlier WLT provenance retained in PF47.
